channel.title: The v/h journal
channel.description: Notes, films and ideas about making technology useful in everyday life.

item.title: What would you like to hear from us?
item.description: How are you today? Tell us what you want to hear from us.

item.title: Design the action and the check together
item.description: A device can follow an instruction and still leave the job unfinished.

item.title: Usable by the person who did not set it up
item.description: The person who didn't set it up should be able to use it.

item.title: Life with v/h: Stay for the story
Life with v/h: Keep the favourite
What an interrupted task should tell you
item.description: If a device stops halfway through a task, 'Try again' isn't enough.

item.title: Less time managing the product
item.description: A useful device can succeed by giving you fewer reasons to interact with it.

item.title: What an everyday utility has to prove
item.description: We want to judge our first utility by an ordinary week of use.

item.title: The core function belongs with the product
item.description: You should be able to use the core function of a product you own without keeping a service running.

item.title: Made to be useful
item.description: You shouldn't have to be interested in technology to benefit from it.

item.title: What we mean by an agent under the hood
item.description: The complicated decisions should happen inside the product.

item.title: Easy to use and useful to many people
item.description: A product can be easy for everyone to use and still be useful to almost no one.
